summary: Selects a cursor by index and activates it. Validates that the requested index a2 is within the cursor count at this[42] (offset 0xA8) and that the handle stored in the cursor-handle slot this[5*a2+12] is non-null; on success it calls SetCursor with that handle and records the selected index at this[43] (offset 0xAC), returning 1. Returns 0 when the index is out of range or the slot handle is null.

local_names.this: cursor-manager object holding the handle array and the selected-index field

operations.description: Validate the index: reject when a2 is negative, when a2 is not less than the cursor count at this[42] (offset 0xA8), or when the handle in slot this[5*a2+12] is null.
Return 0 when the guard fails (out of range or null handle).
Record the selected index: this[43] (offset 0xAC) = a2.
Return 1 to signal a successful selection.

unresolved: The cursor-handle slot is accessed as this[5*a2+12], implying a five-dword (20-byte) slot stride beginning at this[12]; only the first dword handle is consumed and the rest of the slot layout is unproven.
